alternatives.description: Leave current pipeline-health state implicit across issues, workflows, automation definitions and process text.
alternatives.projected_effect: No new semantic rule is created, but material execution and enforcement gaps remain difficult to consume mechanically.
alternatives.risk: Lanes can overstate health, closure or assurance because there is no current typed denominator/health pointer.

alternatives.description: Publish independent PipelineHealthReceipt, RuleEnforcementCoverageReceipt, DerivedLaneRegistry and a current health pointer bound to exact repository heads and ProcessVersion 1.4.
alternatives.projected_effect: Current gaps, dependent freezes, repair debt and reduced-operation state become typed evidence without changing canonical semantics.
alternatives.risk: The audit can become stale after head/lane/config changes; no receipt may be treated as self-authorizing or self-closing.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING lacks a current mechanically consumable health/coverage/lane evidence set.
Published receipts create maintenance/reverification obligations and must be explicitly invalidated by changed bindings.

assumptions: GardenCanonicalUpdateProcess@1.4 is the HUMAN-admitted current governing process.
Garden v15.5 remains the immutable canonical design baseline.
The merged GardenProcess engine is the current route/state implementation substrate but is not yet proof that every consuming lane is end-to-end enforced.
Issue/PR closure alone is not Garden finding closure.
Unknown lifecycle or verification metrics remain UNKNOWN/null rather than being inferred from prose or repository state.
reason.uncertainty: The current repositories do not expose a normalized persisted pending-work/process-instance stream or complete VerificationBinding set, so several health dimensions are intentionally REDUCED_OPERATION or NOT_COMPUTABLE rather than guessed.
counterexamples: A health receipt counting its own closure would violate independent-audit requirements.
A protected action proceeding while its required rule is below RE_VERIFIED would violate admitted v1.4 enforcement maturity.
A semantic review claiming same-cycle blind/cross-exam integrity without a persisted CycleID and packet_hash would be invalid.
Paid-review assurance claimed as normal while budget state cannot be reconciled to v1.4 would be invalid.
A GitHub issue marked closed without FindingClosureReceipt must not be counted as Garden closure.
reason.conclusion: Publish bounded independent health receipts, keep the pipeline in REDUCED_OPERATION where execution evidence is incomplete, throttle new semantic intake at repair-debt score 25, and block only protected actions whose required rule maturity is not met.

obligations.statement: The health pointer resolves to a PipelineHealthReceipt bound to GardenCanonicalUpdateProcess@1.4 and exact audited repository heads.
RuleEnforcementCoverageReceipt uses an exact six-rule denominator and does not claim RE_VERIFIED without a full VerificationBinding.
DerivedLaneRegistry reflects current enabled ChatGPT automations and default-branch GitHub workflow files without granting lane authority.
The audit never treats GitHub issue/PR closure or its own publication as a Garden FindingClosureReceipt.

items.claim_scope: Requires independent PipelineHealthReceipt, exact enforcement coverage, derived lanes, lifecycle health, repair debt and execution-first controls.
Identifies the merged ProcessFactory/GardenProcess route/state substrate.
Records current REDUCED_OPERATION disposition, repair obligations, lifecycle unknowns and dependent freezes.
